page: Amazon Web Services m8in.4xlarge is an x86_64 general purpose instance built on the AWS Nitro System. It is powered by dedicated Intel processors running at 3.9 GHz, delivering 16 virtual CPUs across 8 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. System memory totals 64.0 GB, establishing a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per virtual CPU.

Networking performance and external storage throughput are focal points of the m8in.4xlarge architecture. The instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps and operates as an EBS-optimized node. It includes no integrated local storage or hardware GPU accelerators, necessitating network-attached Amazon Elastic Block Store volumes or remote network filesystems for all persistent storage operations.

The absence of local disks minimizes hardware idle costs for environments utilizing decoupled block storage architectures. Combining dedicated Intel compute cores, balanced memory density, and 25 Gbps baseline networking makes the instance well-suited for network-bound services, relational databases, application runtimes, and intermediate data processing pipelines.
